name: ZETA SURGICAL
long_description: ZETA SURGICAL is redefining the standard of care for image-guided surgery and targeted neuro-therapeutics. Its navigation and robotics platform applies advanced artificial intelligence and computer vision to enable high-accuracy image guidance across virtually any point of care in minutes, unlocking less invasive and more precise targeted therapies. The Zeta Navigation System and Zeta TMS Navigation System are cleared by the FDA and commercially available in the United States.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Raahil is a co-founder of Zeta Surgical, a startup that develops surgical navigation and robotics tools to make minimally invasive surgeries easier, faster and more accessible. He graduated from Harvard in 2018 with a B.A. in Computer Science. Raahil has extensive experience in computational biology and is interested in the intersection of technology and medicine. While not working, Raahil can be spotted using his private pilot's license to fly to scenic locations around the east coast.
